## Data Product Overview
This report visualises the costs associated with repeat dispensing prescriptions, including total expenditure, item volumes, and contractor-level breakdowns. It highlights trends in repeat dispensing activity across practices and regions, providing insight into financial impact and prescribing behaviour. The report is available via ePACT2 for authorised users and Catalyst for aggregated insights, supporting transparency and cost management.

Purpose:
The report helps NHS England, commissioners, and contractors monitor repeat dispensing costs, identify high-cost areas, and ensure prescribing aligns with efficiency and safety standards. It supports budget planning and formulary compliance.

How to Use:
Users can filter by practice, contractor, or region to review repeat dispensing patterns, compare costs, and identify opportunities for optimisation. Commissioners use it for financial planning, audit, and prescribing efficiency programmes, while prescribers and contractors can track their own activity and explore cost-saving alternatives. Public users can view aggregated insights to understand repeat dispensing trends and expenditure.
